ns2:course.label: Recent Anglo-American Phil
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the major philosophical developments in England and America in the 20th century, focusing on such writers as G. E. Moore, Bertrand Russell, A. J. Ayer, Ludwig Wittgenstein, and W. V. Quine. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One course in philosophy.
